title: SIREN — leave-one-chromosome-out reassessment of CRISPRi enhancer–gene baselines and a corrected Enformer silencing analysis

creators.name: Bambini, Gabriele

description: Code, pre-specified analysis plan with dated amendments, audit of an earlier internal release, literature survey, SLURM pipelines and machine-checked result files for a re-analysis of the public EPCrisprBenchmark K562 CRISPRi table: unfitted-distance baseline, leave-one-chromosome-out evaluation with cluster-bootstrap intervals, locus-disjoint transfer, a corrected Enformer in-silico-silencing analysis, and conformal calibration and selection.
